Volna 1.0.8

  • Let go of the key right after your last word. Volna sometimes lost the last word or the last sentence, above all when you speak quietly, so you had to wait before releasing the key. On our recordings the last word is now kept 93% of the time with the key released at once, up from 71%, with no extra wait.
  • Bluetooth headsets. Volna waits for the end of your speech to arrive from a headset before it stops listening.
  • Copy Diagnostics. If a dictation is slow or never arrives, Settings › Diagnostics › Copy Diagnostics copies how long each step of your last dictations took and how each one ended, with your Mac's model and memory, ready to paste into a message to us. It never includes audio or anything you said.
